title: Three brokers now hold 59% of NSE's active clients
dek: Groww's share of NSE active clients rose from 16.4% in March 2023 to 29.4% in October 2026. With Angel One and Zerodha, the top three hold 58.9%, while total active clients are still 5% below their March 2025 peak.

read: With the pool of active traders flat after the F&O curbs, growth now comes from taking share, and that is pooling clients at a few app-led platforms.
sources: NSE broker-wise active client data (March 2023, March 2025, March 2026, October 2026); Vantage analysis
notes: An NSE active client is one who traded on NSE at least once in the previous 12 months; counts are per broker, so a person trading through two brokers counts twice. Shares are of all NSE active clients (4.67 crore in October 2026, 3.27 crore in March 2023); some monthly tallies divide by the top brokers only (about 4.59 crore), which puts Groww nearer 30%. October 2026 counts: Groww 1.37 crore, Angel One 69.98 lakh, Zerodha 67.59 lakh, ICICI Securities about 21.6 lakh and Upstox about 18.4 lakh; Upstox and ICICI Securities shares are derived from those counts. ICICI Securities is now part of ICICI Bank; Zerodha and Upstox are unlisted. FY26 changes compare March 2026 with March 2025 (Groww 1,29,21,210 → 1,29,39,127).
